# Solving the Rush Hour Puzzle

## Identifying the Vehicles

| Vehicle | Orientation | Position |
|---------|------------|----------|
| A (red) | Horizontal | Row 2, Cols 2-3 |
| B | Horizontal | Row 0, Cols 0-1 |
| C | Horizontal | Row 0, Cols 2-3 |
| D | Horizontal | Row 3, Cols 4-5 |
| E | Horizontal | Row 5, Cols 3-5 |
| F | Vertical | Col 0, Rows 1-3 |
| G | Vertical | Col 0, Rows 4-5 |
| H | Vertical | Col 2, Rows 3-5 |
| I | Vertical | Col 3, Rows 3-4 |
| J | Vertical | Col 5, Rows 0-2 |

## Step-by-Step Solution

The key challenge: A is blocked by J on the right, J is blocked by D, D is blocked by I, and I is blocked by A/E — a circular dependency that requires careful sequencing.

| Step | Move | Purpose |
|------|------|---------|
| 1 | A-1 | Clear row 2, col 3 for I to move up |
| 2 | I-2 | Move I up to clear row 3, col 3 for D |
| 3 | D-1 | Move D left to clear row 3, col 5 for J |
| 4 | J+1 | Move J down to clear row 0, col 5 for C |
| 5 | C+2 | Move C right to clear row 0, col 3 for I |
| 6 | I-1 | Move I up to clear row 2, col 3 for A |
| 7 | A+2 | Move A right (now at cols 3-4) |
| 8 | H-1 | Move H up to clear row 5, col 2 for E |
| 9 | E-1 | Move E left to clear row 5, col 5 for J |
| 10 | J+2 | Move J down to clear row 2, col 5 for A |
| 11 | A+1 | **A exits to the right!** |

<answer>A-1 I-2 D-1 J+1 C+2 I-1 A+2 H-1 E-1 J+2 A+1</answer>
